column1: # Which integration suites a changed file touches, for
# `tool/run_android_suites.sh --changed`. Read top to bottom, every matching
# line contributes; the result is a union, never a narrowing.
# Fields are separated by a TAB, patterns and suites by spaces. Patterns are
# shell globs matched against the path from the repository root (`*` crosses
# `/`). Suites are names without `client/integration_test/` and without`.dart`.
# `ALL` and `BOOT` are keywords: the whole set, and the suites that boot the app
# A file that matches nothing here still gets a chance: the runner matches the
# words of its path (`epg_thumbnail.dart` -> `epg`) against the words of every
# suite name. That covers the obvious cases and is what makes this file short;
# when it guesses wrong the run prints the file and the suites it picked, and
# `--changed --dry-run` shows the selection before anything boots.
# Err wide, and say why: a suite that is not selected is a suite that did not
# run. If a change could plausibly reach areas this table does not name, widen
# it here or pass the suites explicitly.
